integrityDisclosure: A broad repository text search displayed already-frozen development-pilot DockQ values. It exposed no proposed holdout target label, coordinate, or result and did not influence target selection.
conclusion: The documented metadata screen records eight candidate structures resolving to seven provisional and zero formally cleared direct GPCR-VHH groups, below the frozen minimum of ten. Because candidate-discovery completeness was not established and formal leakage audits remain incomplete, this checkpoint supports blocking target freeze but not an exhaustive census, an upper bound, or a claim of global public-data infeasibility.
